name: Veterans Memorial Plaza
summary: Veterans Memorial Plaza is a community shopping center on Veterans Memorial Highway in Commack, managed by Kimco Realty. With a 4.4-star rating and over 1,200 reviews, it serves as a convenient retail destination for Long Island families.
demographics: Veterans Memorial Plaza serves the affluent suburban communities of Commack and surrounding Long Island areas, attracting middle to upper-middle income families with household incomes typically ranging from $80,000 to $150,000. The primary shopper demographic consists of families aged 35-65, including working professionals and retirees who value convenience and quality. The trade area draws from a well-educated population with strong purchasing power, typical of Suffolk County's established residential neighborhoods, with shopping patterns focused on everyday needs, dining, and services.
description: Veterans Memorial Plaza is a well-established community shopping center located on Veterans Memorial Highway in Commack, New York, serving the heart of Long Island's Suffolk County. Managed by Kimco Realty, one of North America's largest publicly traded owners and operators of open-air shopping centers, this plaza has been a reliable retail destination for local residents for decades. The center operates daily from 10:00 AM to 9:00 PM, providing convenient access to a mix of retail stores, dining options, and essential services. With a strong 4.4-star rating from over 1,200 Google reviews, Veterans Memorial Plaza has earned the trust and loyalty of the Commack community. Its strategic location along a major thoroughfare ensures excellent visibility and accessibility, making it a go-to destination for everyday shopping needs and family dining in the Long Island area.
